headline: Judge says Trump can't demolish Kennedy Center. And, lawsuits target voter intimidation
context: A federal judge ruled yesterday that President Trump cannot tear down the Kennedy Center without a 30-day notice. And, recent lawsuits seek to keep armed federal officers away from polling sites.

sources.name: NPR
